people.name: Elead
people.line: Ephraimite killed by the men of Gath

people.name: Ezer
people.line: Son of Ephraim; killed by the men of Gath.

people.name: Gath
people.line: Philistine city; home of Goliath; refuge for David

people.name: Zabad
people.line: Son of Ephraim, killed by men of Gath

translations.web: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.
translations.bsb: Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son. Ezer and Elead were killed by the natives of Gath, because they went down to steal their livestock.
translations.kjv: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
translations.asv: and Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in the land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
